has_offer.description: True only when the source states a concrete benefit for the target loyalty programme at the target partner.

benefit_kind.description: Kind of benefit: discount, points, cashback, gift, or other.

value.description: Numeric amount of the benefit when explicitly published; otherwise null. Do not infer a missing percentage or amount.

unit.description: Unit corresponding to value, such as %, RUB, or points; null when value has no published unit.

basis.description: What value is applied to or what earns it, e.g. ticket price or each night. Not a user action and not an accrual deadline.

audience.description: Who is eligible for this target-programme offer, including membership/card status and published tier or segment. Do not broaden to all customers.

restrictions.description: Published scope, limits, exclusions, eligible products/services/locations/tariffs, combining rules, minimums and other conditions. Do not put user actions or accrual timing here.

redemption.description: Only published actions the user must or may take to obtain the benefit, such as buy at a cashier, show a card, enter a member number in a named field, or use a promo code. Do not put the purpose of points here.

promo_code.description: Literal published promo code only. A loyalty member number, card number or account number is not a promo code.

valid_until.description: Explicit end date or end condition of this offer only. Do not use the evaluation date, publication date, booking deadline, or accrual deadline.

accrual_timing.description: When points/cashback/other accrued benefit will be credited relative to an event, preserving any published duration, e.g. within 45 days after checkout. Not the earning basis.

evidence.description: Short verbatim quotations from the target programme section that support the benefit and material conditions. Never quote neighbouring programmes as evidence.

practical_advice.description: Optional low-risk practical inference not stated as a published condition. Keep empty when no separate advice is useful; never duplicate redemption or invent mandatory requirements.

offers.description: Offers belonging only to the target programme. Do not include neighbouring programmes or general concessions.

unknowns.description: Only material facts about the target offer that are genuinely unknown or ambiguous in the source. Do not invent doubts about facts the source states clearly.
